section: Social Studies · Ch48 — Indian & World Geography
subject: Social Studies
stem: India shares a land border with how many neighbouring countries?

options.option_text: Seven (Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Afghanistan)

explanation: India shares land borders with seven countries — Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, and a small stretch with Afghanistan (via Pakistan-occupied Kashmir) — plus additional maritime neighbours like Sri Lanka and Maldives, which do not share a land border.
